research.name: ascii.rest
research.note: Animated ASCII art pieces, from a spinning shaded donut to full-colour dot scenes, for React, Astro or one HTML tag.

effects: 3D shapes such as a lit donut and torus knot rotating as shaded ASCII characters in a <pre>
full-colour landscape scenes drawn as grids of varying-size dots
language and distro logos as ASCII with animated SVG variants for READMEs
